SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - JULY 9, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
7A.
City of Cerritos dated July 9, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated July 9, 2012 in the total amount of $3,799,669.44.
8.
Approval of Treasurer’s Report for the period ending  May 31, 2012 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).
9.
Approval of Minutes
9A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of June 28, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of June 28, 2012.
10.
Miscellaneous
10A.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1142-12, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 On Stage Programs. (COUNCIL)
award Bid No. 1142-12 to Diversified Printers of La Mirada for the Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 On Stage Programs in the amount of $29,693.70.
End of Consent Calendar
If you would like to speak on any of the remaining Agenda items, please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. Speakers will be called upon for comment after the report on the item is given by City staff.
11.
New and Old Business
11A.
Consideration and award of a sole source contract for the repairs, replacement, and rehabilitation for the natural gas engines at several water facilities in the City of Cerritos. (COUNCIL)
1. Find that staff has satisfied the purposes of the bidding regulation of the City of Cerritos code; and
2. Find that it is reasonable and necessary to sole source the repairs and services of the Waukesha engines in accordance with Section 3.20.060 of the City of Cerritos Municipal Code; and
3. Authorize the Senior Assistant City Manager to enter into a contract with Waukesha Pearce Industries, Inc. for the proposed repairs and services.
11B.
Review and consideration of a proposed concept for a lighted art piece by artist Cliff Garten for the Cerritos Sculpture Garden - generally located in the Cerritos Civic Center on the northwest corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street, West of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station (APN 7025-028-904).  (COUNCIL)
review and approve
1.  The lighted art piece proposed by artist Cliff Garten, shown as "Infinity 2" in the Cerritos Sculpture Garden a shown in the subject report;>
2.  Approve the appropriation in the amount not to exceed $275,000 from the Art in Public Places Trust Fund for subject art piece; and
3.  Direct staff to negotiate subject contract for the construction and installation of the lighted art piece, "Infinity 2" for the Cerritos Sculpture Garden.
11C.
Review and consideration of Cerritos Iron-Wood Nine Golf Course Green Fees. (COUNCIL)
approve the green fee increase as proposed by the Parks and Recreation Commission.
12.
Report on Pending Legislation
12A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
12B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
13.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
14.
Adjournment
